name: Demo flat
description: A refurbished 55 m² flat in Barcelona: brick vaults on timber beams, an open kitchen behind sliding oak panels, three bedrooms. Furnished, with a guided tour of saved views.
credit: Modelled after a flat by Allaround Lab (2017), photos José Hevia.

project.name: Demo flat
project.description: Modelled over MCP by an AI agent after a refurbished flat by Allaround Lab (2017), photos José Hevia.

materials.name: Larch cladding boards, oiled (120 × 4000, horizontal on walls)
Solid oak, natural oiled (stairs, balusters, linings)
Solid ash, honey lacquer (dining table, chairs)
Terrazzo, white with grey and black chips, polished (600 × 600 slabs)

items.name: Low bench along the south wall
LED strip under the wall cabinets

parameters.label: Handle side of a single door
Handle side of a single door

material.expr: hash(s + i, 4) < 0.167 ? 'navy' : hash(s + i, 4) < 0.333 ? 'oxblood' : hash(s + i, 4) < 0.5 ? 'ochre' : hash(s + i, 4) < 0.667 ? 'cream' : hash(s + i, 4) < 0.833 ? 'green' : 'grey'

parts.name: Leaf
parts.x: open ? (i < half ? i * 12 : W - lw - (n - 1 - i) * 12) : i * (lw - overlap)
parts.z: open ? D - ((i < half ? i : n - 1 - i) + 1) * (lt + gap) + gap : (i % 2 == 0 ? D - lt : D - 2 * lt - gap)

parts.name: Pull
parts.x: (open ? (i < half ? i * 12 : W - lw - (n - 1 - i) * 12) : i * (lw - overlap)) + (i < half ? lw - 96 : 60)
parts.z: (open ? D - ((i < half ? i : n - 1 - i) + 1) * (lt + gap) + gap : (i % 2 == 0 ? D - lt : D - 2 * lt - gap)) + lt
